cases.name: P0-canonical
cases.reason: canonical signature-positive payload in a single TCP segment

cases.name: P1-boundary-segments
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload split at parser and required-content boundaries

cases.name: P2-many-small-segments
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload split into many small TCP segments

cases.name: P3-retransmission
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload with one byte-identical retransmitted data segment

cases.name: N-banner-changed
cases.reason: greeting no longer carries the rsync daemon banner

cases.name: N-framing-marker-changed
cases.reason: message framing marker bytes are altered

cases.name: N-negotiation-tag-changed
cases.reason: checksum negotiation tag byte is altered

cases.name: N-tag-before-framing-marker
cases.reason: negotiation tag appears before the framing marker it must follow

cases.name: N-flag-high-bit-clear
cases.reason: flag byte after the tag has its high bit clear

cases.name: N-seed-length-at-lower-bound
cases.reason: seed length is exactly 16, which the greater-than test rejects

cases.name: N-seed-length-at-upper-bound
cases.reason: seed length is exactly 65, which the less-than test rejects

cases.name: N-wrong-port
cases.reason: canonical payload is sent to an adjacent non-rsync port

cases.name: N-wrong-destination-address
cases.reason: canonical payload is sent to a server outside the monitored network

cases.name: N-flow-not-established
cases.reason: canonical payload is sent without a completed TCP handshake

cases.name: N-wrong-direction
cases.reason: canonical payload is replayed to client; the rule only inspects client-to-server data

cases.name: N-random-rsync-handshake
cases.reason: protocol-valid rsync version handshake and module listing with no exploit layout
